introduction: Investigate the village raids and missing miners, help a worried mother, and explore the gnome's independent mixtures and the tower challenge. Exact current materials prepare a request; acceptance records its outcome. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK mayor about mine or insect, then ASK captain about insects for the suspected burrow. ASK foreman or miner about mine, troubles or miners for the disappearances. These conversations explain the routes; neither referral nor every dialogue keyword is a separate achievement or required receipt.

The mayor accepts one exact mantis queen heart and one exact demon ambassador wing together for diamond platemail and a vitality cloak. Carry both loose and offer one of them to submit the full bundle. The proofs have separate sources and access routes. Supplied exact proofs fit without your own kills, prior captain conversation or personal door-opening history.

Search the village's concealed downward passage near its southern wall to reach the burrows. Native searching can reveal the actual shared exit. The royal wall needs the exact royal emblem from a mantis guard captain, or another valid native unlocking or already-open route. That emblem is a key which breaks on native unlocking. It is not one of the mayor's two offerings.

The mines descend through deeper shafts into undead chambers. Their liches and vampires mutter pieces of the tomb name. At the magical tomb gate, SAY mortazoth can unlock the current locked door when speech is permitted; OPEN the tomb if it remains closed. Another player's opening can already provide access. Speaking a name does not prove that you learned it yourself or defeated the ambassador.

ASK weeping about crying or kara for her missing daughter. The native rescue accepts the exact carried girl item from the mine alcove for a ruby ring. This is an item-return request rather than an NPC escort. Carry the girl loose to the mother; supplied custody fits without a personal rescue, miner referral, kill or mayor completion.

ASK gnome about ingredients, potion or potions for five independent mixtures. Fungus alone makes an adrenaline potion; weed+moss+orchid makes green potion; rose+orchid makes swirling potion; moss+weed+rose makes strange elixir; lotus+rose makes sweet smelling potion. Carry each recipe's full exact set loose together. One accepted mixture does not complete the others or leave its spent ingredients available for reuse.

Village garden stock includes lotus, roses, orchids and weeds. Fungus actually has three limited burrow placements; the gnome describes finding it along the southern wall. Moss has limited burrow and mine stock. Search concealed stock where native visibility requires it. Gifts and existing exact stock fit; generic flowers, herbs, diamonds, potion rewards or historical possession do not replace current ingredients.

The tower overseer describes a 100 platinum entrance fee for the exact diamond key. Paid key issuance is a service, separate from winning the tower challenge. The five successive gladiators carry distinct emerald, sapphire, golden, ruby and obsidian keys for its later locked routes. Exact supplied keys, native picking or an already-open route can fit where allowed; paying once is not proof of kills or treasury recovery. The accounting payment adapter still needs qualification before this service is available in an active epoch.

Bargor exchanges the exact remote heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet together for the Constitution scroll. Other givers consume those same remote materials for different outcomes. The tablet's prose mentions an artifact which Bargor's actual recipe does not require. Its supply and the scroll's claimed stat power remain unresolved; the journal records the declared exchange without promising that reading grants constitution.

Bargor's forge and enchant remarks are ambient speech. His old epic-training table entry does not establish an available enchant lesson or a quest reward. Jallev's weapon lore, ordinary shops, diamonds, the rune stone, the Oasis memory and the alien-looking object beyond the queen remain separate from these accepted requests.

Current exact loose materials are preparation. Worn, held, nested, handed-away or spent items do not satisfy those rows, and holding a reward does not prove acceptance. Limited stock, reset timing, shared doors and other players affect availability. Three story receipts contribute achievements and potential dailies; six services remain visible without that credit. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting; daily eligibility does not guarantee fresh stock.
